\subsection*{Complete unit coordinates for A.159}
The four units in A.159 have the following literal definitions.  Put
\[B=10^{40},\qquad e_i=t^i/d^{\lfloor2i/3\rfloor}\quad(0\leq i\leq8).\]
Each $e_i$ is integral, since its ninth power is the integer
$3^i d^{6i-9\lfloor2i/3\rfloor}$.  Set $u_1=\alpha^2-2$.
For $j=2,3,4$, the tables define $u_j=\sum_{i=0}^8 a_{j,i}e_i$ by
\[a_{j,i}=\epsilon_{j,i}\sum_{k\geq0}b_{j,i,k}B^k.\]
A row labelled $(i,k,\epsilon)$ supplies the two successive blocks
$b_{j,i,k},b_{j,i,k+1}$.  Unlisted blocks are zero.
The sign is repeated for readability.  The tables are generated from the
exact candidate coordinates and reconstruct them without rounding.
